summary: Quezon City 3rd District representative with 84 principal-authored bills. Authored 4Ps expansion, a social pension for indigent PWDs, lifetime validity of PWD IDs, air passenger rights and compensation, an open harbor pilotage framework, a plastic excise, travel-tax abolition and a digital budget portal for government transactions.
caveat: Digital budget portal is a single institutions issue and unscored.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Authored 4Ps expansion and a social pension for indigent PWDs (-3) and air passenger rights (-2), against an open harbor pilotage framework (+2) and tax items near neutral: travel tax abolition (+1), plastic excise (-1).
